question: how many teachers were in aims ttp's fifth training round
answer: 51 in-service Mathematics teachers, from the English-speaking sub-system, trained by 10 Master Trainers and TTP staff starting 10 September.
evidence: AIMS TTP kicked off its fifth (5 th ) training of 51 in-service mathematics teachers in Cameroon

question: did a government minister visit the aims ttp training
answer: Yes — the Minister of Secondary Education, Prof. Nalova Lyonga, surprised the trainees on 14 September 2018.
